title: apply_impulse strange behavior
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.1.rc2.mono.official [abef5e0d2]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.rc2.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700 (24 threads)

### Issue description

I want test the apply_impulse method, and i create a node3d scene like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/14ce4d0c-d212-49ca-a157-c7e4fe2d591b)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4efcf7e5-88cf-4644-83dd-46a99283aa0e)
attach GDS like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/289ff55b-2c89-4f09-b108-986f0b6add30)

then I'm create a test scene like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16776500-76cd-443f-bc89-74041561b343)

note i'm add 3 impluse components.
and code like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/573c4c5e-7c2f-4537-a585-bcf93b672f2c)

when code like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/00f5dcb2-59fe-468c-9c2a-1dbb9bffaee2)
the strange thing was body always up whatever the body was rotated.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ab2f3fac-9f5a-43e1-8818-c0cc661d38a3)

maybe my code was not right, so i'm change my code like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/132ef2b7-e2d1-4fe6-8396-1d352fa47d56)
when press up key, the body like move the right way.
but when i pressed left key, it runaway to left-bottom direction

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7cceb575-9454-4906-8aaf-3126bb69eeed)
because i'm set the body's gravity's scale to 0, and the left impulse compont was location at the body's top_right.
so i think the right was: the body will keep rotate when i press left key.

### Steps to reproduce

please run the MRP

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[impulsetest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19459249/impulsetest.zip)
